draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The package only reports original-label results (T1) and no statistical tests. There is no T2, no noise-perturbation experiment, and no F1-drop values. The claim's numbers (0.6, 1.3, 1.8) and the robustness conclusion are entirely unsupported by the supplied evidence.
